The first target now has two accepted certificates, one from S0 and one from SC. They are the same fourteen-row primitive proof of one already-known statement. The previous SC run reached 600 extensions without a proof on the first target. In this new run it reaches the ordinary control result in 14. All 144 word-reference controls and complete model correspondence checks belong to admitted jobs. Certified failure markings remove twelve initial incidences in each paired marked comparison per case. These shallow exclusions are not a learned multiscale proof abstraction.

All ground registry queries remain Native UNKNOWN, unadmitted, with usable empty. No inference block, trained RL policy or physical universal Wang qualification is introduced.

The next separate test should give all four point arms the same general formula-novelty preference among candidates at the Graph-selected branch point, retain every primitive alternative and the mandatory scheduler, and measure whether useful receptors become available. This is a prospective heuristic, with no predicted recovery or advantage.

The full program remains practical boundary tiling, hierarchical receptor and lemma inventories, learned proposal policies, automated arithmetic and symbolic Hilbert geometry, and honest conventional benchmarks. Turtle/Penrose plane constructions and the universal Wang bridge remain unfinished.
